notesEn: 0.3.68: session projection-cache guard. When DSH refuses to create a session with 'session/agent-busy: ... is owned by subagent routing', the plugin now (1) catches it in the client by wrapping sessions.create, reports the session id to the host, drops the stale sessionId and retries once; (2) host-side clears <DshHome>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json by MOVING it to <DshHome>/logs/session-cache-guard-backup/ (never deleted) so DSH rebuilds it from the session log; (3) a timer sweeps every 3 minutes for the same class of stale cache (cache says blank while the log already has turn/start or user/message and a newer seq). New route /config-sync/cache-guard (GET read-only scan; POST scan|sweep|clear|busy) and a cacheGuard switch in settings, default on.
notes: 0.3.68: 会话投影缓存守卫。DSH 报 'session/agent-busy: … is owned by subagent routing' 导致新建会话失败时：①客户端包一层 sessions.create，撞上就把 sessionId 报给宿主、去掉旧 sessionId 重试一次；②宿主把 <DshHome>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json 挪到 <DshHome>/logs/session-cache-guard-backup/（只挪不删），让 DSH 按会话日志重建；③定时每 3 分钟扫一遍同类陈旧缓存（缓存标空、日志却已有 turn/start 或 user/message 且 seq 更新）。新增路由 /config-sync/cache-guard（GET 只读扫描；POST scan|sweep|clear|busy），设置里新增 cacheGuard 开关，默认开。
